title: Former governor, political journalists will participate in Dole Institute’s 2026 Post Election Conference
summary_en: A former Kansas governor, national political reporters, and Democratic and Republican strategists are among the panelists who will join the Robert J. Dole Institute of Politics' 2026 Post Election Conference on Dec. 9.
title_cn: Former governor, political journalists will participate in Dole Institute’s 2026 Post Election Conference

title: Theories of when people first entered American continents evaluated for compatibility with genomic evidence
summary_en: Jennifer Raff, associate professor of anthropology at the University of Kansas, reviewed various models for early migrations into the Western Hemisphere, considering their compatibility with genetic, archaeological and environmental evidence.
title_cn: Theories of when people first entered American continents evaluated for compatibility with genomic evidence

title: KU Libraries to host typewriter type-in with student repair expert, collector
summary_en: KU Libraries will bring part of student Jonathan Swanberg’s typewriter collection to Watson Library for “Watson Type-In: Exploring Typewriter History, Technology and Freedom of Speech” on Dec. 1.
title_cn: KU Libraries to host typewriter type-in with student repair expert, collector

title: KU scholar forms Courageous Minority movement, international group to create conditions for educational revolution
summary_en: Yong Zhao, an education researcher at the University of Kansas, has organized a group of scholars across five continents dedicated to reimagining education in the age of artificial intelligence. Zhao published new work about the cause in the academic journal Interchange: A Quarterly Review of Education.
title_cn: KU scholar forms Courageous Minority movement, international group to create conditions for educational revolution

title: KPR’s Live Day returns with full slate of performances at Lawrence Public Library
summary_en: Kansas Public Radio’s Live Day will return this fall with seven live classical concerts for the community Nov. 13. Area musicians will perform at Lawrence Public Library; concerts and free and open to the public.
title_cn: KPR’s Live Day returns with full slate of performances at Lawrence Public Library
